title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
events_chronological: Joel and Clementine meet at a beach party in Montauk and break into an empty house on the shore.
Over two years they fall in love - the ice on the frozen Charles, the Chinese restaurant, the drive-in.
The relationship curdles into recrimination over Clementine's drinking and Joel's withholding.
Clementine comes home drunk having dented Joel's car, and the fight ends with her walking out for good.
Clementine hires Lacuna Inc. to erase every memory of Joel from her mind.
Joel visits the bookstore and finds Clementine treating him as a stranger and flirting with Patrick.
Carrie and Rob show Joel the form letter from Lacuna, and he goes to Dr. Mierzwiak demanding the same procedure.
Joel boxes up every object connected with Clementine so that Lacuna can map the memories attached to them.
Stan and Patrick run the overnight erasure in Joel's apartment, and Patrick pockets Joel's mementos to use on Clementine.
Inside his own head Joel watches the most recent and ugliest memories dissolve around him one by one.
Reaching the memories he loves, Joel changes his mind and tries to smuggle Clementine into memories she was never part of.
Stan and Mary get high on Joel's bed and lose track of the procedure as his map goes off the rails.
Mierzwiak arrives to re-map the erasure, and Mary kisses him - only for his wife to reveal that Mary's own affair with him was erased.
In the last surviving memory, the Montauk beach house, Joel and Clementine say goodbye and she tells him to meet her in Montauk.
The erasure completes and Joel wakes the next morning with no memory that Clementine ever existed.
Joel skips work on an impulse he cannot account for, takes the train to Montauk and meets Clementine on the frozen beach.
They drive back to the city together and she invites him up to her apartment.
Mary quits Lacuna and mails the files and session tapes back to every patient on the books.
Joel and Clementine listen to their own recorded voices tearing each other apart; she runs, comes back, and they agree to try anyway.
syuzhet_notes: Told-order bullets 1-2 are a false opening: they are chronologically the film's penultimate act, and only the closing scenes reveal that the couple have met before. Everything from told-order bullet 6 to bullet 17 takes place during the single night of the erasure, with Joel's memories replayed in reverse chronological order - told-order bullets 9, 10, 13 and 15 are the memories themselves, running backwards from the break-up to the first meeting.
fabula_notes: Clementine's own visit to Lacuna is never dramatised; it is inferred from the form letter Joel's friends show him. The two-year arc of the relationship exists only as the memories Joel revisits during the procedure, so its internal chronology is reconstructed from the order in which the machine deletes them.
